WAGES BOARDS ORDINANCE
Notification
WAGES BOARD FOR THE BAKERY TRADE

IT is hereby notified under Regulation 30 of the Wages Board regulations publilshed in Gazette No. 14961 dated 04.06.1971 thatthe Hon Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations has been pleased to appoint the following persons to be members ofthe Wages Board for the Bakery Trade, by the virture of the powers vested in the Hon. Minister of Labour and Trade UnionRelations under Section 09 of the Wages Boards Ordinance (Chapter 136) No. 27 of 1941, for a period of three years commencingon 1st of November 2018.
R. P. RAJAPAKSHA,Secretary,Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relation.
Labour Secretariat,Colombo 05.28th March, 2019.
Nominated Members01. Mr. S. S. Ranaweera02. Mr. G. M. Somasiri Perera03. Mr. Chamara Subhasinghe
